name: Silph Co. Lower Floors (1F–5F)
summary: Infiltrate the 11-story headquarters of the Silph Company, currently occupied by Team Rocket forces. Navigate through the lower floors, battling corrupt Scientists and Rocket Grunts. Reach 5F to defeat Rocket Ricky and secure the all-important Card Key, unlocking every security gate across the complex.

items.name: Card Key
items.method: Ground pickup in the southern hallway of 5F past Rocket Ricky

items.name: TM107 Play Rough
items.method: On the floor in the 4F staff recreation room

items.name: DNA Splicers
items.method: Hidden inside a decorative flower pot on 2F near the stairwell

items.name: Protein
items.method: In the western 5F storage locker unlocked using the Card Key
